short: A sweeping set of social and military reforms attributed to the legendary lawgiver Lycurgus, which transformed Sparta into a deeply militarized society.
full:
According to ancient tradition, Lycurgus established the Great Rhetra, completely restructuring Spartan government and society following a period of unrest and slave revolts. These reforms introduced the dual kingship alongside the Gerousia (council of elders) and the ephors, balancing monarchic, oligarchic, and democratic elements in a unique constitutional mix.

Crucially, the reforms instituted the agoge, a rigorous state-sponsored education and training program for all male citizens. It also established the syssitia, communal messes that fostered equality and military cohesion among Spartiates, ensuring that Sparta would emerge as the dominant land power in Greece for centuries.
